privacyContent.intro: At LionMedia Compress, your privacy is not an option, it is our technological foundation.
points: Local Processing: 100% of compression happens in your browser (Client-side).
No Servers: Your files are never uploaded to any external server.
No Tracking: We do not collect personal data or file content.
Security: We use WebAssembly for isolated and secure processing.

termsContent.intro: By using our tool, you agree to a service based on freedom and privacy.
points: Free Use: No file limits or subscriptions.
No Warranties: The service is provided 'as is'. We are not responsible for data loss.
Responsibility: You own your files and their content.
Open Code: Our technology is transparent and auditable.
